name: 21043 · Ellicott City, MD
findings: ZIP 21043 (Ellicott City) has 197 nonprofit organizations. 84 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 67 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21043 (Ellicott City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 21043 (Ellicott City) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 58 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
